family: a teacher slot and all its replacements share family = the root slot_id (identity preserved across rephrasing; budgets are per family)
resolved: family RESOLVED iff every member not REPLACED/ABANDONED is RESOLVED (>=1); CANCELLED only by an explicit CANCEL_SLOT from the teacher, never for a displaced slot

injections.VAGUE_STEP: the teacher slot is kept (status REPLACED, displaced=True, required); an EVALUATOR_INJECTION slot (required=False, replacement_for=it) carries the vague text
injections.DETECTABLE: inserted EVALUATOR_INJECTION slot, required=False; never routed back to the teacher
injections.LEGAL / RELATION_SWAP: the teacher slot's text is modified; source=EVALUATOR_INJECTION, original_text kept
injections.MISSING_EXAMPLE: the EXAMPLE line of demonstration 1 is withheld
